name: Blaze Knucklecap
description: Slip in from above the guard line and jab the fist down onto the exposed brow.

name: Granite Fingerplate
description: Settle the cuffed arm high and still like a perched hawk and let blows slide off the steel.

name: Siltclench
description: Spring back on light feet to a longer range and keep both gloves raised.

name: Wringmettle
description: Touch the steel palm to the shoulder so the second hand's blow has a mark to follow.

name: Mittscourge
description: Drive the plated elbow along the line of the coming stoop to crack the guard open.

name: Glovevalor
description: Catch a counter on the open palm plate and turn it past the shoulder.

name: Devastating Backhandplate
description: Dive the fingerplates through the chosen mark so they punch past the breastplate rim.

name: Thorn Wristcuff
description: Clamp the marked limb in the steel hand and hold it fast while the other fist is readied.

name: Rumble Crushgrip
description: Gather the whole qi field above the shoulder and dive the fist to burst through plate and the body behind it.

name: Tempered Clench
description: Open from the attack hand with a straight punch while the guard hand holds its post.

name: Cuffplate Tenacity
description: Hold the guard cuff before the face so the attack hand may swing without fear.

name: Blinding Seizeup
description: Slide a step to the side so the guard hand becomes the attack hand.

name: Vambhavoc
description: Rap the steel backplate on the opponent's lead hand to test his reply.

name: Clamphavoc
description: Trade the duties of the two gloves mid-blow so that one hand guards as the other lands.

name: Unconquered Gauntcuff
description: Pivot the shoulders so the guard cuff meets the blow squarely and sends it wide.

name: Unsparing Grasp
description: Surge a pulse of qi into the attack hand as the guard hand pins the opponent's arm.

name: Unrelenting Elbowcop
description: Turn a heavy blow wide with the guard hand and drive the attack hand through the opening.

name: Shade Palmguard
description: Press both gauntlets on the opponent's arms and hold them down by field pressure alone.

name: Verity Vambrace
description: Meet a blow with the guard gauntlet and turn all its force back through the attack fist on the same breath.

name: Rumble Clamp
description: Press the steel palm against the ribs and lean the whole weight down through it.

name: Aegismitt
description: Raise the cuff like the rim of a basin to catch a falling blow.

name: Gustvamb
description: Settle the hips low and shuffle forward without lifting the feet.

name: Gustgrasp
description: Let the fist fall slow and heavy as water and settle onto the opponent's guard.

name: Shattering Clench
description: Hook the steel fingers over the rim of a raised guard and tip it back.

name: Fastening Thumbplate
description: Close both gloves round the opponent's torso and tighten slowly with each breath.

name: Shadewring
description: Squeeze the clamped arm until the muscle gives and the grip on any weapon fails.

name: Mittinsight
description: Rest the steel palm on a held limb and feel its pull and strain through the glove.

name: Might Wring
description: Thrust the palm forward when the clinch is full and spill the stored force into the chest.

name: Thumbplate Scourge
description: Drive the cuff edge into a joint of the armor so the stored pressure bursts through the gap.

name: Numbing Palmguard Fortitude
description: Hold the clinch until the pressure peaks then release all of it through the palm into the opponent's core.

name: Vengeful Clamp
description: Jab the plated fist along the line of least resistance into a gap in the guard.

name: Murk Cuffplate
description: Part a blow around the cuff like water round a rock and let it pass.

name: Silt Backhandplate
description: Slide through the gaps between attackers in a smooth unbroken line.

name: Granite Wristcuff
description: Feel for the hollow beside a raised guard and send the steel fist flowing into it.

name: Blazewring
description: Meet a blocking cuff with rising qi and carry the fist through it like a flood through a dam.

name: Evergreen Vambrace
description: Turn the cuff to lead a heavy blow down the arm and away at the elbow.

name: Wringwrath
description: Pour both fists down from the same height in a roaring pair that smashes any guard below.

name: Wringvalor
description: Wind the steel fingers along the arm to its nerve points and seal the flow of qi there.

name: Lightning Knucklecap
description: Flow through the gap between two blows like water between stones and land the fist behind the guard.

name: Gust Seizeup
description: Rise on the toes and lift the steel fist up under the chin in one climbing motion.

name: Unrelenting Fingerplate
description: Hold the cuff steady against a push like a post standing in a stream.

name: Torrent Wring
description: Tuck both arms in close like folded wings and slide through a narrow gap.

name: Blistering Gauntcuff
description: Draw the opponent's lead hand across then whip the steel backhand along the same line.

name: Lightning Crushgrip
description: Fix the gaze on a single point and glide forward without shifting the head.

name: Wringhavoc
description: Stoop onto the opponent's guard with one fist and pull his arm down with the other glove.

name: Thornglove
description: Let the cuff ride the push of a blow a pace sideways and take its force along the arm.

name: Chime Backhandplate
description: Sweep the curled fingerplates down across the opponent's wrists and break his grip on a weapon.

name: Invincible Elbowcop
description: Spin the guard arm in a tight circle and send a thrust spiraling past the ribs.

name: Clenchhavoc
description: Drop the fist from high while the lower hand drags the guard downstream and the blow lands clean.

name: Thornclench
description: Draw the opponent's arm under the cuff and lock it there while qi holds the pull steady.

name: Gnashing Fingerplate
description: Dive from the high line and let the pull of the current drag the fist through the guard to the body inside the armor.

name: Granite Grasp
description: Jab the lead fist while the rear hand closes in behind it on the same line.

name: Hoarfrost Cuffplate
description: Swing the cuff across the body like a door closing against a blow.

name: Torrential Crushgrip
description: Take short steps that narrow the opponent's room on both sides at once.

name: Blazeclench
description: Bring the loaded rear fist down in a hammer stroke on a guard already worn by the lead hand.

name: Gyve Clamp
description: Close both gloves on one arm from either side and press it flat against the body.

name: Might Knucklecap
description: Cross the rear fist over the pinned arm with a pulse of qi to finish the exchange.

name: Facet Thumbplate
description: Hold both cuffs closed before the chest while qi stiffens the joined steel against a charge.

name: Wristcuff Havoc
description: Bring both gauntlets together on the opponent's torso from either side in a single crushing clap.

name: Clampvalor
description: Pin wrist and elbow between both steel palms and seal the arm's qi between them.

name: Might Gauntcuff
description: Pour field qi into both gauntlets together so the closing blow lands with the full weight of the closed pair.

name: Iron Vambrace
description: Throw the steel fist straight from a stance that gives up no cover and fears none.

name: Aegis Palmguard
description: Lift the cuff overhead against a blow from above and meet it squarely.

name: Ghosting Wring
description: Step along the edge of the opponent's reach as the wind slides along a ridge.

name: Glovescourge
description: Breathe in the wind and surge forward with it behind the fist for a long reaching blow.

name: Chime Clench
description: Sweep the free arm in a sudden flat gust to throw aside an incoming weapon hand.

name: Murkglove
description: Turn the cuff from an open stance and shed a thrust along the forearm.

name: Tempered Vambrace
description: Drive the fingerplates forward on a surge of wind-driven qi that splits a plate seam.

name: Thornmitt
description: Catch an arm with the open steel hand and hold it with steady qi against a violent pull.

name: Lotmitt
description: Strike the steel palm on the sternum and seal the qi of the whole body the way a gale stills a flame.

name: Corroding Elbowcop
description: Jab the plated fist straight along the bearing and hold the line after the blow.

name: Iron Wristcuff
description: Hold the cuff firm like a stone on the plateau and let blows break upon it.

name: Headlong Grasp
description: Tread forward against the wind with short steady steps and the fist leading.

name: Clamp Reckoning
description: Whip the backhand along the opponent's guard line as if along the lip of a scarp.

name: Torrential Grasp
description: Back away along a narrow lane through the grass with the guard cuff raised.

name: Might Crushgrip
description: Hold the bearing and let the plated hammer drop on the same mark again and again.

name: Thorn Elbowcop
description: Hold the forearm steady against a sustained assault with qi renewed on each breath.

name: Equipoise Cuffplate
description: Parry a swing sideways as the upland wind turns a drifting seed.

name: Suffocating Fingerplate
description: Press the opponent's guard arm down along the bearing until it stops resisting.

name: Glint Seizeup
description: Drive the fist along the sworn bearing so the whole stance punches through a guard.

name: Ponderous Wring
description: Pin the opponent's arm to his flank on the windward side with the steel forearm.

name: Murkvamb
description: Take a hard cut on the cuff and return it through the fist before the cutter recovers.

name: Dampening Gauntcuff
description: Hold the oath bearing and let the steel forearm null the force of a qi blow that strikes it squarely.

name: Blaze Backhandplate
description: Jab the fist in a short sharp gust of breath at the opponent's lead shoulder.

name: Indomitable Thumbplate
description: Angle the cuff across the line of a blow like a hull heeled against a crosswind.

name: Silt Crushgrip
description: Slide to a new bearing around the opponent and square the shoulders on his weaker side.

name: Wrathful Knucklecap
description: Hammer the steel fist onto the weakest line of the opponent's stance.

name: Ruinous Knucklecap
description: Read the tilt of the opponent's stance and place the fist where the weight is falling.

name: Adamantine Elbowcop
description: Correct the cuff's heading mid-block and turn a swing onto the wrong line.

name: Waning Vambrace
description: Rest the steel palm on a guarded arm and feel through it where the weakness lies.

name: Lancing Palmguard
description: Drive the fist along the fault found in the guard so the force passes through it.

name: Corroding Backhandplate
description: Rain hammer blows along the weak line in a sustained flurry that pins the opponent behind his guard.

name: Titanic Clench
description: Find the fault in the stance through the glove and drive one blow into it to collapse the whole guard.

name: Ferocious Seizeup
description: Take a long stride and jab the plated fist at the end of it.

name: Iron Fingerplate
description: Breathe out slowly as the cuff takes a blow so the arm never tenses.

name: Mightgrasp
description: Keep pace beside the opponent's drift and stay a fist's length from him.

name: Wristcuff Scourge
description: Chain backhands from one hand to the other so the steel backplates never stop moving.

name: Torrent Gauntcuff
description: Rest the cuff between blows and lift it only at the last instant to slap a counter away.

name: Graspwrath
description: Hold one long breath and swing the fist down in a heavy stroke that lasts the whole exhale.

name: Unconquered Thumbplate
description: Slip the cuff along the lane of an incoming blow and shed it behind the hip.

name: Gust Palmguard
description: Push off with qi and follow a retreating opponent stride for stride.

name: Might Clamp
description: Pour a continuous stream of blows from both fists for as long as the breath holds.

name: Mastering Clench
description: Wrap the steel forearm round the opponent's arm at the end of a long stride and haul it across.

name: Blinding Wristcuff Blink
description: Cross the whole distance in the space of one breath and land the steel fist before the opponent sees the stride.

name: Glovehavoc
description: Jab once with a single sworn fist and hold the other hand back as a guard.

name: Unbudging Vambrace
description: Crouch and cover with the cuff as if on a bare slope with no rock to shelter behind.

name: Granite Clench
description: Slide round a loose stone underfoot to keep the footing and the bearing.

name: Blaze Cuffplate
description: Swing the single sworn fist down with all the weight of the body behind it.

name: Palmguard Valor
description: Turn the cuff on open ground to send a thrust past without giving back a step.

name: Ponderous Seizeup
description: Drift the steel hand over a swinging wrist and close the fingers on it.

name: Glint Wring
description: Drive the fingerplates through a defender's guard with no feint and no shelter for either side.

name: Granite Elbowcop
description: Hold the open steel hand before the chest and keep qi steady against a heavy press.

name: Vital Thumbplate
description: Swear the blow aloud on one long breath and let the field gather in the fist until it strikes harder than the arm could.

name: Wrathful Crushgrip
description: Swing the heaviest glove on a fixed bearing and let its weight finish the arc.

name: Indomitable Fingerplate
description: Let the heavy cuff drop onto an incoming blow and settle there under its own weight.

name: Meteoric Clamp
description: Lean into the wind and step so the heavy glove swings without pulling the body over.

name: Rumblevamb
description: Swing the leaden backplate wide and let the glove's weight carry it round to the ear.

name: Flintlike Cuffplate
description: Haul the heavy hand back across the body after a swing to turn aside the counter.

name: Vengeful Wring
description: Press the bearing forward and drop the heavy fist where the bearing ends.

name: Charter Backhandplate
description: Cushion a heavy hit by letting the cuff yield a hand's breadth before it stiffens.

name: Mitthavoc
description: Lean the whole glove forward into the opponent's chest and push as the wind pushes a door.

name: Equipoise Knucklecap
description: Pivot with the weight of the glove to sweep a spear aside and recover in the same turn.

name: Wringruin
description: Drop the heavy glove with gale pressure behind it so it crushes through a raised arm.

name: Overbearing Grasp
description: Lay the heavy glove on the opponent's arm and hold it down along the bearing.

name: Grievous Seizeup Reckoning
description: Let the full gale pressure settle into the heavy glove and drop it so the force ignores armor and lands in the body.
